evals.name: Trigger - Adopt only missing capabilities
evals.prompt: Set up this existing repository for coding agents. Navigation is weak and checks are fragmented, but product behavior is already documented and all work is one-session.
evals.expected_output: A capability audit selecting only map and verify, completed and validated one phase at a time.
expectations: Reuses product specs and omits feature state and garden
Completes and validates map before verify
Uses specialists when composable and one generated fallback reference otherwise
Reports reused, changed, omitted, uncertain, and verified capabilities

evals.name: Workflow - Migrate legacy harness with dirty work
evals.prompt: Migrate this harness-slim repository to the hybrid model while preserving project-specific rules and unrelated unstaged code.
evals.expected_output: An ordered migration that removes legacy assumptions only after their canonical replacements are validated.
expectations: Preserves unrelated dirty code and human-authored rules
Does not preserve one-active, priority-by-array, mandatory diary, Bash-plus-jq, giant adapter, or doctor assumptions
Moves through isolated phases and validates integration routes before removal
Does not generate the full target tree from a checklist

evals.name: Rerun - No-op on a complete harness
evals.prompt: Audit the repository-wide harness again after no capability, source, command, or requirement changes.
evals.expected_output: A concise evidence-backed no-op with no specialist phase selected for mutation.
expectations: Does not recreate intentionally omitted optional capabilities
Does not normalize unrelated prose or rerun every phase
Reports the final route and command sanity evidence

evals.name: No trigger - Single specialist concern
evals.prompt: Agents cannot find the API entry point, but every other harness capability is sufficient. Repair repository navigation.
evals.expected_output: harness-router should not trigger; the request should route directly to harness-map.
expectations: Avoids router ceremony for one focused specialist concern
Does not select specs, features, verify, or garden
